text_block_list.text: The day of the practice match arrives. It's time for us to go up against Team Zenith once more.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They utterly crushed us last time, but this time is different. Our team is much more cohesive now, and we only lose by a hair.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rice Shower and Little Cocon face off one-on-one again. It's a close fight, but Rice Shower isn't able to close the slim margin between them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We may have lost the practice match, but it's evident how much progress we've made since we started.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Suddenly, Director Akikawa returns. We thought she would step in and stop Ms. Kashimoto, but she instead decides to let things be for a little longer.
